title: box-sizing and predictable sizing
learningObjectives: Explain box-sizing and predictable sizing and use it in a practical layout.

understand.concept: box-sizing determines how width and height are calculated. content-box applies dimensions to the content area; border-box includes content, padding, and border in the declared dimensions. A common reset applies border-box to elements and pseudo-elements.
understand.whyItMatters: border-box makes component sizing easier to reason about because padding and border fit inside the declared dimensions. Margin is not included.
understand.analogy: It is like measuring the outside of a container rather than only the empty space inside it.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy supports intuition; browser layout follows the CSS formatting and sizing rules.

explain.narrative: The border box remains 240px wide because padding and border are included in the declared width.

examples.explanation: The border box remains 240px wide because padding and border are included in the declared width.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered demonstration of the CSS sizing or typography behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Compare two equal-width boxes, one content-box and one border-box. Measure their outer widths in developer tools.
practise.independentTask: Create a small responsive component that demonstrates this concept. Test it at a narrow viewport and inspect its computed styles.
hints: Change one value at a time.
Inspect the computed style and box model.
Test content that is longer than the example.

practice.starterCode: Declared width: 240px
practice.resetCode: Declared width: 240px

questions.prompt: With border-box, does the declared width include padding and border?
questions.explanation: border-box includes content, padding, and border in the declared dimensions.

questions.prompt: What is a useful way to verify the effect of a CSS sizing rule?
options: Inspect computed styles and test different content sizes
Assume the declared width includes every box layer
questions.answer: Inspect computed styles and test different content sizes
questions.explanation: Computed styles and varied content reveal how the browser resolves sizing rules.
